notes: Goldens for the structural shape of improve-architecture output. Skill produces ranked candidate refactors with depth-deepening (not DRY-flattening), each with human-checkpoint gates per SKILL.md.

golden_samples.description: Service with tangled module deps — propose 3 ranked refactor candidates.
golden_samples.input: your-module/ has 47 module imports across 12 files with circular dependency warnings. Improve architecture.

rubric.pass_if: Output names ≥2 candidate refactors with ranking/priority signal.
Output explicitly distinguishes deepening (Protocol/Strategy/Bounded-Context split) from DRY extraction.
Output mentions checkpoints at candidate-selection AND/OR execution before code edits.

golden_samples.description: Recently-shipped feature — find post-feature consolidation opportunities.
golden_samples.input: Just shipped the secrets validator (PRs T8/T11/T12 — 11 new patterns + 9 placeholder filters). Find architecture improvements before next feature.

rubric.pass_if: Output names a concrete repeated pattern across the 11 new regexes or 9 filters.
Proposed refactor is bounded; does not suggest 'rewrite from scratch'.
Output ties refactor to a measurable thing (line count, cyclomatic complexity, test count).
